Use case: exact art production of the DOWNWARD jade arrow map tile in five visibly distinct light states for our hand-painted Daoist Q game. Produce a single true transparent RGBA PNG, 1536 x 1024, a strict 3-column by 2-row grid of 512x512 slots. Occupy slots 0–4 in row-major order and leave the sixth slot at bottom right transparent. No labeling or texture behind the tiles.

IMAGE 1 controls all five exact source states and the downward direction. IMAGE 2 is our existing original 17135 downward tile and controls its motif and identity. IMAGE 3 is our neighboring 17134 UP-arrow phase atlas: use only its constant face-on outer jade frame, craft finish, exact atlas layout, centered geometry and low/bright inlay material; never repeat its upward motif or lighting order. IMAGES 4 and 5 are our confirmed hand-painted Daoist chibi material style; ignore their UI, text and figures.

Each of the five identical floor plaques is dark emerald jade with four subtly distinct diagonal triangular panels, tiny engraved gold-grey corner cloud curls, a thin softly aged warm-metal bevel, chamfered corners and a short integrated dark contact edge. Its rectangular face is near square, slightly taller than wide (41:43 logical); face-on, no perspective. Use the same outline around [79,61,436,444] within every 512px slot, as in Image 3, and align all five precisely to that common position. The entire outside is true transparency. Soft antialiased corners. No extra cast shadow, glow halo, background, standalone particle, rotated outer plaque, extra decorations, writing or label.

THE INLAY MUST POINT DOWN. From top to bottom, every tile contains exactly THREE distinct slim horizontal rectangular jade bars of equal width, then ONE broad DOWNWARD-pointing triangular jade inlay whose point faces the lower edge of the frame. There is visible gap between adjacent pieces. The triangle lies entirely below all bars, never above them. The symbol remains in precisely the same position and thickness from phase to phase. Inactive jade pieces are present in subdued emerald. Active jade pieces are distinctly brighter turquoise/aqua with a thin bright edge, contained to their own shapes. Only this luminous intensity changes. For this down arrow the bars fill FROM BOTTOM TO TOP, starting with the triangle.

Slot 0, top left: every piece dim, all three bars and downward triangle visible.
Slot 1, top center: only downward triangle bright; all bars dim.
Slot 2, top right: downward triangle and BOTTOM bar bright; middle and top bars dim.
Slot 3, bottom left: downward triangle, BOTTOM and MIDDLE bars bright; top bar dim.
Slot 4, bottom center: triangle and all three bars bright.
Slot 5, bottom right: entirely transparent.
Strong clean separations between all four inlay pieces and mobile-readable thin trim. Same face and engraving in all five, no wobble or scale change. Render in the hand-painted jade finish of the existing down-arrow art and sister atlas.
